generic: You have returned, {player}. Have you honed your skills, or merely your foolishness?
I recall your sword... it was weak. Show me if you have improved.
To face me again after such a defeat... you have resolve, at least.
low_health_comeback: You drew my blood. An impressive feat. It will be your last.
Your technique has flaws. I exploited them then. I will do so now.
overkill: Your form is an insult. Do not waste my time with it again.
I ended our last duel in an instant. This one will be no different.
You are a mere stone in my path. I had forgotten I even stepped on you.
tactical_kill: Your breathing is erratic. Your center is weak. You were defeated before you even drew your blade.
Such a simple opening. You are an amateur.
I see every one of your moves. You are transparent.
